name: inline-duplicated-component
signals: same widget/JSX subtree instantiated 3+ times with copy-pasted styling; per-item layout builders inlined at call sites
recommendation: extract a shared parameterized component (per-repo copy for Flutter apps); call sites become data

name: dead-code-copy-of-live-component
signals: an unused widget file mirroring a live component; grep finds zero imports
recommendation: delete it — two sources of one pattern is how regressions stay unknown

name: copy-pasted-style-literals
signals: same padding/radius/hex repeated across unrelated widgets
recommendation: promote to const tokens or theme roles instead of literals

name: spacing-rhythm-break
signals: ad-hoc paddings breaking the 4/8 grid; inconsistent gutter between sibling screens
recommendation: normalize to the 4/8 rhythm; use the app's spacing scale

name: fixed-size-clipping-content
signals: fixed heights/widths on text-bearing containers; overflow hidden without ellipsis
recommendation: intrinsic sizing, or ellipsize with maxLines; test with longest realistic strings

name: density-above-profile
signals: more than ~7 interactive elements on a prime mobile screen; stacked competing CTAs
recommendation: progressive disclosure; one primary action per screen

name: misaligned-sibling-columns
signals: columns whose widths/baselines differ across items of the same kind
recommendation: shared header row component or consistent cross-axis alignment

name: contrast-below-wcag
signals: text contrast <4.5:1 (normal size) or <3:1 (large text/UI icons); low-contrast borders on interactive boxes
recommendation: raise to threshold; verify in BOTH light and dark themes

name: state-holes
signals: data screens with no loading/empty/error+retry branch; futures awaited without failure UI
recommendation: add the missing branches; error states must offer retry and preserve input

name: icon-only-no-label
signals: icon-only buttons without tooltip/semanticLabel/aria-label
recommendation: add an accessible name; decorative icons must be hidden from the tree

name: affordance-missing
signals: interactive items that don't look tappable (no ripple/hover/CTA styling); no press feedback
recommendation: affordances look interactive; consistent press feedback within 150ms

name: unbounded-overlay-panel
signals: OverlayEntry/portal overlays without explicit size constraints or anchors; StackFit.expand fallthrough takes the full window
recommendation: cap both axes on the panel root; measure the anchor via GlobalKey; return Positioned directly from overlayChildBuilder

name: sticky-content-collision
signals: fixed/sticky bars overlapping scrollable content; content hidden under notches or the keyboard
recommendation: scroll insets accounting for viewInsets + safe areas

name: z-order-blanket
signals: full-bleed gesture blockers above content without justification; z-index stacks hiding focus
recommendation: scope the interceptor to its reason; verify focus isn't obscured

name: relational-target-fail
signals: targets <24 css px either axis, or adjacent targets <8 css px apart, or overlapping activation zones
recommendation: 24 css px floor + spacing; keep 44pt/48dp as the practical recommendation for primary actions

name: glance-target-in-motion
signals: driver-profile tap targets <48dp where the vehicle may be in motion
recommendation: size up to 48-56dp for in-motion actions; consider voice/HUD alternatives

name: color-only-status
signals: state conveyed only by color (red/green chips or badges without icon/shape/text)
recommendation: pair color with icon/shape/text; color is never the sole channel

name: semantics-order-broken
signals: screen reader order mismatches visual order; unlabeled containers; roles missing on custom widgets
recommendation: fix semantics order + add missing labels/roles; verify with a real screen reader

name: focus-invisible-or-trapped
signals: invisible focus indicators; keyboard/DPad focus trapped in overlays; dialog close doesn't return focus
recommendation: visible focus ring; returning focus to the trigger on dismissal

name: motion-without-reduced-motion
signals: entrance/scroll animations without a prefers-reduced-motion / disableAnimations guard
recommendation: guard motion branches; provide a static fallback

name: entry-point-gap
signals: a screen cannot be reached with valid state from some entry point (deep link, notification, error route, first-run)
recommendation: repair the entry chain; every entry lands somewhere intentional with speaker-honest state

name: dead-end-screen
signals: screens with no forward path and no exit; screens unreachable in practice
recommendation: add exit/next; delete orphans

name: back-behavior-inconsistent
signals: dialogs/drawers/back dismissing differently across screens; interrupted submission losing input
recommendation: unify dismissal; preserve state across interruptions

name: irrevocable-without-confirm
signals: destructive actions (cancel ride, delete doc, withdraw) firing without confirm or undo
recommendation: confirm + undo where feasible

name: cross-screen-object-confusion
signals: same object (ride, route, passenger) named or formatted differently between list → detail → confirmation
recommendation: one canonical name/date/time format per object across screens

name: generic-error-copy
signals: errors saying only 'Something went wrong' when a specific server message was available
recommendation: surface the server's specific reason (descriptive errors); prescribe the next step

name: terminology-drift
signals: same feature named differently across screens (Vehicle vs Car; trip vs ride)
recommendation: single terminology source; sweep variants

name: responsive-break-frame
signals: layout only verified at one width; fixed pixel paddings/widths breaking below 360px; horizontal scroll on phones; overflow at 1728 wide
recommendation: verify at realistic widths (320/375/430 phone portrait; ~768 tablet; 1440/1728 desktop) - same content, one verdict per width

name: sibling-token-drift
signals: same color ROLE resolving to different values across sibling apps (e.g. one app's page tint vs its sibling's neutral)
recommendation: reconcile to the declared policy: unified apps share role values; themed-variants map deltas to documented roles

name: sibling-component-parity
signals: shared components with different anatomy across siblings (overlay picker in one app, stock dropdown in its sibling)
recommendation: same anatomy + interaction grammar across siblings; differences allowed only on declared theme axes

name: cross-app-language-drift
signals: same action/object named differently across sibling apps (Book vs Reserve; trip vs ride used inconsistently)
recommendation: one cross-suite glossary; sweep sibling app strings

name: class-fit-deviation
signals: system behaves against its claimed class (task app with admin-console density; in-vehicle surface with hover-only affordances; marketing page demanding data-reading)
recommendation: surface as Class-fit finding citing the fingerprint axis violated

name: not-found-offers-recovery
signals: 404/not-found states that dead-end (single message, no paths); or worse: blank/stack-trace dumps
recommendation: structured not-found: explanation + primary recovery (home/retry) + secondary path (help/community); where feasible turn the miss into value

name: boot-state-branded
signals: app boot/initial-load shows plain blank screen or generic spinner with no identity
recommendation: branded boot state (logo after first paint); never blank — the first seconds are part of the UX

name: delta-color-policy
signals: delta/summary colors applied without a documented semantic policy (direction-based vs goodness-based; e.g. bounce-rate 'improving' rendered red under direction-policy)
recommendation: document the policy in the design system; apply consistently; visually disambiguate semantics where the two policies disagree

name: breakpoint-chrome-grammar
signals: sidebar hides without an accessible drawer; top bar carrying row-level actions; nav pattern identical across breakpoints with no transitions
recommendation: breakpoint grammar: expanded sidebar (>=1280) -> icon-rail (~1024-1280) -> hamburger drawer (<1024); top bar carries global context only

name: drawer-vs-modal-choice
signals: modals used for contextual side-by-side detail; drawers used for focused state-changing decisions on small screens
recommendation: drawers = contextual/side-by-side; modals = focused state-changing; small screens force modal/sheet for detail

name: sidebar-collapsibility
signals: sidebar collapses to nothing with no icon-rail; expanded sidebar stealing fixed width from dense tables
recommendation: icon-rail intermediate state; persist user choice; keyboard reachable
